Nvidia's board officially rules out bringing back co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO.
Evidence: France 24, TechCrunch, BBC reports

Nvidia's board ruled that co-founder Jensen Huang will not return as CEO despite public interest and investor calls.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Nvidia board rules that co-founder Jensen Huang will not return as CEO

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Nvidia board rules that co-founder Jensen Huang will not return as CEO ===

[Source 1 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261117-nvidia-board-rules-that-co-founder-jensen-huang-will-not-return-as-ceo):
Nvidia board rules that co-founder Jensen Huang will not return as CEO

Nvidia's board chairman ruled out bringing back co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO on Tuesday, as the chipmaker forecast stronger-than-expected quarterly sales but faced growing questions over its leadership, national security exposure and long-term strategy following his abrupt departure.

[Source 2 — techcrunch.com (Bias: Center / Technology)] (URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/jensen-huang-says-he-would-be-honored-if-allowed-to-return-as-nvidia-ceo/):
Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

[Source 3 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwx2en2vrxmdo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him

Huang says he has had an "outpouring" of calls from investors and others calling for him to return.
